structural_differential.event_level: [Wind_Below ∧ Thunder_Above] → Thunder and wind, enduring movement
structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Thunder and wind: the image of DURATION. Thus the superior man stands firm and does not change his direction.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: DURATION. Success. No blame. Perseverance furthers. It furthers one to have somewhere to go.

1.text_six: Seeking duration too hastily brings misfortune persistently. Nothing that would further.

2.text_nine: Remorse disappears.

3.text_nine: He who does not give duration to his character meets with disgrace. Persistent humiliation.

4.text_nine: No game in the field.

5.text_six: Giving duration to one's character through perseverance. This is good fortune for a woman, misfortune for a man.

6.text_six: Restlessness as an enduring condition brings misfortune.

structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Mountain under heaven. Thus the superior man keeps the inferior man at a distance, not angrily but with reserve.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: RETREAT. Success. In what is small, perseverance furthers.

1.text_six: At the tail in retreat. This is dangerous. One must not wish to undertake anything.

2.text_six: He holds him fast with yellow oxhide. No one can tear him loose.

3.text_nine: A halted retreat is nerve-wracking and dangerous. To retain people as men- and maidservants brings good fortune.

4.text_nine: Voluntary retreat brings good fortune to the superior man and downfall to the inferior man.

5.text_nine: Friendly retreat. Perseverance brings good fortune.

6.text_nine: Cheerful retreat. Everything serves to further.

structural_differential.event_level: [Heaven_Below ∧ Thunder_Above] → Thunder in heaven, great power
structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Thunder in heaven above. Thus the superior man does not tread upon paths that do not accord with established order.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: THE POWER OF THE GREAT. Perseverance furthers.

1.text_nine: Power in the toes. Continuing brings misfortune. This is certainly true.

2.text_nine: Perseverance brings good fortune.

3.text_nine: The inferior man works through power. The superior man does not act thus. To continue is dangerous. A goat butts against a hedge and gets its horns entangled.

4.text_nine: Perseverance brings good fortune. Remorse disappears. The hedge opens; there is no entanglement. Power depends upon the axle of a big cart.

5.text_six: Loses the goat with ease. No remorse.

6.text_six: A goat butts against a hedge. It cannot go backward, it cannot go forward. Nothing serves to further. If one notes the difficulty, this brings good fortune.

structural_differential.object_level: The Image: The sun rises over the earth. Thus the superior man himself brightens his bright virtue.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: PROGRESS. The powerful prince is honored with horses in large numbers. In a single day he is granted audience three times.

1.text_six: Progressing, but turned back. Perseverance brings good fortune. If one meets with no confidence, one should remain calm. No mistake.

2.text_six: Progressing, but in sorrow. Perseverance brings good fortune. Then one obtains great happiness from one's ancestress.

3.text_six: All are in accord. Remorse disappears.

4.text_nine: Progress like a hamster. Perseverance brings danger.

5.text_six: Remorse disappears. Take not gain and loss to heart. Undertakings bring good fortune. Everything serves to further.

6.text_nine: Making progress with the horns is permissible only for the purpose of punishing one's own city. To be conscious of danger brings good fortune. No blame. Perseverance brings humiliation.

structural_differential.object_level: The Image: The light has sunk into the earth. Thus does the superior man live with the great mass: he veils his light, yet still shines.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: DARKENING OF THE LIGHT. In adversity it furthers one to be persevering.

1.text_nine: Darkening of the light during flight. He lowers his wings. The superior man does not eat for three days on his wanderings. But he has somewhere to go. The host has occasion to gossip about him.

2.text_six: Darkening of the light injures him in the left thigh. He gives aid with the strength of a horse. Good fortune.

3.text_nine: Darkening of the light during the hunt in the south. Their great leader is captured. One must not expect perseverance too soon.

4.text_six: He penetrates the left side of the belly. One gets at the very heart of the darkening of the light, and leaves gate and courtyard.

5.text_six: Darkening of the light as with Prince Chi. Perseverance furthers.

6.text_six: Not light but darkness. First he climbed up to heaven, then he plunged into the depths of the earth.

structural_differential.event_level: [Fire_Below ∧ Wind_Above] → Fire kindling wind, domestic warmth
structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Wind comes forth from fire. Thus the superior man has substance in his words and duration in his way of life.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: THE FAMILY. The perseverance of the woman furthers.

1.text_nine: Firm seclusion within the family. Remorse disappears.

2.text_six: She should not follow her whims. She must attend within to the food. Perseverance brings good fortune.

3.text_nine: When tempers flare up in the family, too great severity brings remorse. Good fortune nonetheless. When woman and child dally and laugh, it leads in the end to humiliation.

4.text_six: She is the treasure of the house. Great good fortune.

5.text_nine: As a king he approaches his family. Fear not. Good fortune.

6.text_nine: His work commands respect. In the end good fortune comes.

structural_differential.event_level: [Lake_Below ∧ Fire_Above] → Fire rises, water sinks, divergence
structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Above, fire; below, the lake. Thus amid all fellowship the superior man retains his individuality.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: OPPOSITION. In small matters, good fortune.

1.text_nine: Remorse disappears. If you lose your horse, do not run after it; it will come back of its own accord. When you see evil people, guard yourself against mistakes.

2.text_nine: One meets his lord in a narrow street. No blame.

3.text_six: One sees the wagon dragged back, the oxen halted, a man's hair and nose cut off. Not a good beginning, but a good end.

4.text_nine: Isolated through opposition, one meets a like-minded man with whom one can associate in good faith. Despite the danger, no blame.

5.text_six: Remorse disappears. The companion bites his way through the wrappings. If one goes to him, how could it be a mistake?

6.text_nine: Isolated through opposition, one sees one's companion as a pig covered with dirt, as a wagon full of devils. First one draws a bow against him, then one lays the bow aside. He is not a robber; he will woo at the right time. As one goes, rain falls; then good fortune comes.

structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Water on the mountain. Thus the superior man turns his attention to himself and molds his character.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: OBSTRUCTION. The southwest furthers. The northeast does not further. It furthers one to see the great man. Perseverance brings good fortune.

1.text_six: Going leads to obstructions, coming meets with praise.

2.text_six: The king's servant is beset by obstruction upon obstruction, but it is not his own fault.

3.text_nine: Going leads to obstructions; hence he comes back.

4.text_six: Going leads to obstructions, coming leads to union.

5.text_nine: In the midst of the greatest obstructions, friends come.

6.text_six: Going leads to obstructions, coming leads to great good fortune. It furthers one to see the great man.

structural_differential.event_level: [Water_Below ∧ Thunder_Above] → Thunder and rain, release of tension
structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Thunder and rain set in. Thus the superior man forgives mistakes and pardons misdeeds.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: DELIVERANCE. The southwest furthers. If there is no longer anything where one has to go, return brings good fortune. If there is still something where one has to go, hastening brings good fortune.

1.text_six: Without blame.

2.text_nine: One kills three foxes in the field and receives a yellow arrow. Perseverance brings good fortune.

3.text_six: If a man carries a burden on his back and nonetheless rides in a carriage, he thereby encourages robbers to draw near. Perseverance leads to humiliation.

4.text_nine: Deliver yourself from your great toe. Then the companion comes, and him you can trust.

5.text_six: If only the superior man can deliver himself, it brings good fortune. Thus he proves to inferior men that he is in earnest.

6.text_six: The prince shoots at a hawk on a high wall. He kills it. Everything serves to further.

structural_differential.object_level: The Image: At the foot of the mountain, the lake. Thus the superior man controls his anger and restrains his instincts.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: DECREASE combined with sincerity brings about supreme good fortune without blame. One may be persevering in this. It furthers one to undertake something. How is this to be carried out? One may use two small bowls for the sacrifice.

1.text_nine: Going quickly when one's tasks are finished is without blame. But one must reflect on how much one may decrease others.

2.text_nine: Perseverance furthers. To undertake something brings misfortune. Without decreasing oneself, one is able to bring increase to others.

3.text_six: When three people journey together, their number decreases by one. When one man journeys alone, he finds a companion.

4.text_six: If a man decreases his faults, it makes the other hasten to come and rejoice. No blame.

5.text_six: Someone does indeed increase him. Ten pairs of tortoises cannot oppose it. Supreme good fortune.

6.text_nine: If one is increased without depriving others, there is no blame. Perseverance brings good fortune. It furthers one to undertake something. One obtains servants but no longer has a separate home.

structural_differential.event_level: [Thunder_Below ∧ Wind_Above] → Wind and thunder, mutual strengthening
structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Wind and thunder: the image of INCREASE. Thus the superior man: if he sees good, he imitates it; if he has faults, he rids himself of them.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: INCREASE. It furthers one to undertake something. It furthers one to cross the great water.

1.text_nine: It furthers one to accomplish great deeds. Supreme good fortune. No blame.

2.text_six: Someone does indeed increase him; ten pairs of tortoises cannot oppose it. Constant perseverance brings good fortune. The king presents him before God. Good fortune.

3.text_six: One is enriched through unfortunate events. No blame, if you are sincere and walk in the middle, and report with a seal to the prince.

4.text_six: If you walk in the middle and report to the prince, he will follow. It furthers one to be used in the removal of the capital.

5.text_nine: If in truth you have a kind heart, ask not. Supreme good fortune. Truly, kindness will be recognized as your virtue.

6.text_nine: He brings increase to no one. Indeed, someone even strikes him. He does not keep his heart constantly steady. Misfortune.

structural_differential.event_level: [Heaven_Below ∧ Lake_Above] → Lake risen to heaven, breakthrough
structural_differential.object_level: The Image: The lake has risen up to heaven. Thus the superior man dispenses riches downward and refrains from resting on his virtue.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: BREAKTHROUGH. One must resolutely make the matter known at the court of the king. It must be announced truthfully. Danger. It is necessary to notify one's own city. It does not further to resort to arms. It furthers one to undertake something.

1.text_nine: Mighty in the forward-striding toes. When one goes and is not equal to the task, one makes a mistake.

2.text_nine: A cry of alarm. Arms at evening and at night. Fear nothing.

3.text_nine: To be powerful in the cheekbones brings misfortune. The superior man is firmly resolved. He walks alone and is caught in the rain. He is bespattered, and people murmur against him. No blame.

4.text_nine: There is no skin on his thighs, and walking comes hard. If a man were to let himself be led like a sheep, remorse would disappear. But if these words are heard, they will not be believed.

5.text_nine: In dealing with weeds, firm resolution is necessary. Walking in the middle remains free of blame.

6.text_six: No cry. In the end misfortune comes.

structural_differential.event_level: [Wind_Below ∧ Heaven_Above] → Wind under heaven, pervasive meeting
structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Under heaven, wind. Thus does the prince act when disseminating his commands and proclaiming them to the four quarters of heaven.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: COMING TO MEET. The maiden is powerful. One should not marry such a maiden.

1.text_six: It must be checked with a brake of bronze. Perseverance brings good fortune. If one lets it take its course, one experiences misfortune. Even a lean pig has it in him to rage around.

2.text_nine: There is a fish in the tank. No blame. Does not further guests.

3.text_nine: There is no skin on his thighs, and walking comes hard. If one is mindful of the danger, no great mistake is made.

4.text_nine: No fish in the tank. This leads to misfortune.

5.text_nine: A melon covered with willow leaves. Hidden lines. Then it drops down to one from heaven.

6.text_nine: He comes to meet with his horns. Humiliation. No blame.

structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Over the earth, the lake. Thus the superior man renews his weapons in order to meet the unforeseen.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: GATHERING TOGETHER. Success. The king approaches his temple. It furthers one to see the great man. This brings success. Perseverance furthers. To bring great offerings creates good fortune. It furthers one to undertake something.

1.text_six: If you are sincere, but not to the end, there will sometimes be confusion, sometimes gathering together. If you call out, then after one grasp of the hand you can laugh again. Regret not. Going is without blame.

2.text_six: Letting oneself be drawn brings good fortune and remains blameless. If one is sincere, it furthers one to bring even a small offering.

3.text_six: Gathering together amid sighs. Nothing that would further. Going is without blame. Slight humiliation.

4.text_nine: Great good fortune. No blame.

5.text_nine: If in gathering together one has position, this brings no blame. If there are some who are not yet sincerely in the work, sublime and enduring perseverance is needed. Then remorse disappears.

6.text_six: Lamenting and sighing, floods of tears. No blame.

structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Within the earth, wood grows. Thus the superior man of devoted character heaps up small things in order to achieve something high and great.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: PUSHING UPWARD has supreme success. One must see the great man. Fear not. Departure toward the south brings good fortune.

1.text_six: Pushing upward that meets with confidence brings great good fortune.

2.text_nine: If one is sincere, it furthers one to bring even a small offering. No blame.

3.text_nine: One pushes upward into an empty city.

4.text_six: The king offers him Mount Ch'i. Good fortune. No blame.

5.text_six: Perseverance brings good fortune. One pushes upward by steps.

6.text_six: Pushing upward in darkness. It furthers one to be unremittingly persevering.

structural_differential.object_level: The Image: There is no water in the lake. Thus the superior man stakes his life on following his will.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: OPPRESSION. Success. Perseverance. The great man brings about good fortune. No blame. When one has something to say, it is not believed.

1.text_six: One sits oppressed under a bare tree and strays into a gloomy valley. For three years one sees nothing.

2.text_nine: One is oppressed while at meat and drink. The man with the scarlet knee bands is just coming. It furthers one to offer sacrifice. To set forth brings misfortune. No blame.

3.text_six: A man permits himself to be oppressed by stone, and leans on thorns and thistles. He enters his house and does not see his wife. Misfortune.

4.text_nine: He comes very quietly, oppressed in a golden carriage. Humiliation, but the end is reached.

5.text_nine: His nose and feet are cut off. Oppression at the hands of the man with the purple knee bands. Joy comes softly. It furthers one to make offerings and libations.

6.text_six: He is oppressed by creeping vines. He moves uncertainly and says, 'Movement brings remorse.' If one feels remorse over this and makes a start, good fortune comes.

structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Water over wood: the image of THE WELL. Thus the superior man encourages the people at their work, and exhorts them to help one another.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: THE WELL. The town may be changed, but the well cannot be changed. It neither decreases nor increases. They come and go and draw from the well. If one gets down almost to the water and the rope does not go all the way, or the jug breaks, it brings misfortune.

1.text_six: One does not drink the mud of the well. No animals come to an old well.

2.text_nine: At the well hole one shoots fishes. The jug is broken and leaks.

3.text_nine: The well is cleaned, but no one drinks from it. This is my heart's sorrow, for one might draw from it. If the king were clear-minded, good fortune might be enjoyed in common.

4.text_six: The well is being lined. No blame.

5.text_nine: In the well there is a clear, cold spring from which one can drink.

6.text_six: One draws from the well without hindrance. It is dependable. Supreme good fortune.

structural_differential.event_level: [Fire_Below ∧ Lake_Above] → Fire and water in conflict, transformation
structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Fire in the lake: the image of REVOLUTION. Thus the superior man sets the calendar in order and makes the seasons clear.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: REVOLUTION. On your own day you are believed. Supreme success, furthering through perseverance. Remorse disappears.

1.text_nine: Wrapped in the hide of a yellow cow.

2.text_six: When one's own day comes, one may create revolution. Starting brings good fortune. No blame.

3.text_nine: Starting brings misfortune. Perseverance brings danger. When talk of revolution has gone the rounds three times, one may commit himself, and men will believe him.

4.text_nine: Remorse disappears. Men believe him. Changing the form of government brings good fortune.

5.text_nine: The great man changes like a tiger. Even before he questions the oracle he is believed.

6.text_six: The superior man changes like a panther. The inferior man molts in the face. Starting brings misfortune. To remain persevering brings good fortune.

structural_differential.event_level: [Wind_Below ∧ Fire_Above] → Wood feeding fire, sacrificial vessel
structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Fire over wood. Thus the superior man consolidates his fate by making his position correct.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: THE CALDRON. Supreme good fortune. Success.

1.text_six: A ting with legs upturned. Furthers removal of stagnating stuff. One takes a concubine for the sake of her son. No blame.

2.text_nine: There is food in the ting. My comrades are envious, but they cannot harm me. Good fortune.

3.text_nine: The handle of the ting is altered. One is impeded in his way of life. The fat of the pheasant is not eaten. Once rain falls, remorse is spent. Good fortune comes in the end.

4.text_nine: The legs of the ting are broken. The prince's meal is spilled and his person is soiled. Misfortune.

5.text_six: The ting has yellow handles, golden carrying rings. Perseverance furthers.

6.text_nine: The ting has rings of jade. Great good fortune. Nothing that would not act to further.

structural_differential.event_level: Σ(Chên₂) → Thunder doubled, shock upon shock
structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Thunder repeated: the image of SHOCK. Thus in fear and trembling the superior man sets his life in order and examines himself.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: SHOCK brings success. Shock comes—oh, oh! Laughing words—ha, ha! The shock terrifies for a hundred miles, and he does not let fall the sacrificial spoon and chalice.

1.text_nine: Shock comes—oh, oh! Then follow laughing words—ha, ha! Good fortune.

2.text_six: Shock comes bringing danger. A hundred thousand times you lose your treasures and must climb the nine hills. Do not go in pursuit of them. After seven days you will get them back again.

3.text_six: Shock comes and makes one distraught. If shock spurs to action, one remains free of misfortune.

4.text_nine: Shock is mired.

5.text_six: Shock goes hither and thither. Danger. However, nothing at all is lost. Yet there are things to be done.

6.text_six: Shock brings ruin and terrified gazing around. Going ahead brings misfortune. If it has not yet touched one's own body but has reached one's neighbor first, there is no blame. One's comrades have something to talk about.

structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Mountains standing close together. Thus the superior man does not permit his thoughts to go beyond his situation.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: KEEPING STILL. Keeping his back still so that he no longer feels his body. He goes into his courtyard and does not see his people. No blame.

1.text_six: Keeping his toes still. No blame. Continued perseverance furthers.

2.text_six: Keeping his calves still. He cannot rescue him whom he follows. His heart is not glad.

3.text_nine: Keeping his hips still. Making his sacrum stiff. Dangerous. The heart suffocates.

4.text_six: Keeping his trunk still. No blame.

5.text_six: Keeping his jaws still. The words have order. Remorse disappears.

6.text_nine: Noble-hearted keeping still. Good fortune.

structural_differential.event_level: [Mountain_Below ∧ Wind_Above] → Tree on mountain, gradual growth
structural_differential.object_level: The Image: On the mountain, a tree. Thus the superior man abides in dignity and virtue, in order to improve the mores.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: DEVELOPMENT. The maiden is given in marriage. Good fortune. Perseverance furthers.

1.text_six: The wild goose gradually draws near the shore. The young son is in danger. There is talk. No blame.

2.text_six: The wild goose gradually draws near the cliff. Eating and drinking in peace and concord. Good fortune.

3.text_nine: The wild goose gradually draws near the plateau. The man goes forth and does not return. The woman carries a child but does not bring it forth. Misfortune. It furthers one to fight off robbers.

4.text_six: The wild goose gradually draws near the tree. Perhaps it will find a flat branch. No blame.

5.text_nine: The wild goose gradually draws near the summit. For three years the woman has no child. In the end nothing can hinder her. Good fortune.

6.text_nine: The wild goose gradually draws near the cloud heights. Its feathers can be used for the sacred dance. Good fortune.

structural_differential.event_level: [Lake_Below ∧ Thunder_Above] → Thunder over lake, improper union
structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Thunder over the lake. Thus the superior man understands the transitory in the light of the eternity of the end.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: THE MARRYING MAIDEN. Undertakings bring misfortune. Nothing that would further.

1.text_nine: The marrying maiden as a concubine. A lame man who is able to tread. Undertakings bring good fortune.

2.text_nine: A one-eyed man who is able to see. The perseverance of a solitary man furthers.

3.text_six: The marrying maiden as a slave. She marries as a concubine.

4.text_nine: The marrying maiden draws out the allotted time. A late marriage comes in due course.

5.text_six: The sovereign I gave his daughter in marriage. The embroidered garments of the princess were not as gorgeous as those of the serving maid. The moon that is nearly full brings good fortune.

6.text_six: The woman holds the basket, but there are no fruits in it. The man stabs the sheep, but no blood flows. Nothing that acts to further.

structural_differential.event_level: [Fire_Below ∧ Thunder_Above] → Lightning and thunder, peak brilliance
structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Both thunder and lightning come. Thus the superior man decides lawsuits and carries out punishments.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: ABUNDANCE has success. The king attains abundance. Be not sad. Be like the sun at midday.

1.text_nine: When a man meets his destined ruler, they can be together ten days, and it is not a mistake. Going meets with recognition.

2.text_six: The curtain is of such fullness that the polestars can be seen at noon. Through going one meets with mistrust and hate. If one rouses him through truth, good fortune comes.

3.text_nine: The underbrush is of such abundance that the small stars can be seen at noon. He breaks his right arm. No blame.

4.text_nine: The curtain is of such fullness that the polestars can be seen at noon. He meets his ruler, who is of like kind. Good fortune.

5.text_six: Lines are coming. Blessing and fame draw near. Good fortune.

6.text_six: His house is in a state of abundance. He screens off his family. He peers through the gate and no longer perceives anyone. For three years he sees nothing. Misfortune.

structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Fire on the mountain. Thus the superior man is clear-minded and cautious in imposing penalties, and protracts no lawsuits.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: THE WANDERER. Success through smallness. Perseverance brings good fortune to the wanderer.

1.text_six: If the wanderer busies himself with trivial things, he draws down misfortune upon himself.

2.text_six: The wanderer comes to an inn. He has his property with him. He wins the steadfastness of a young servant.

3.text_nine: The wanderer's inn burns down. He loses the steadfastness of his young servant. Danger.

4.text_nine: The wanderer rests in a shelter. He obtains his property and an ax. My heart is not glad.

5.text_six: He shoots a pheasant. It drops with the first arrow. In the end this brings both praise and office.

6.text_nine: The bird's nest burns up. The wanderer laughs at first, then must needs lament and weep. Through carelessness he loses his cow. Misfortune.

structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Winds following one upon the other. Thus the superior man spreads his commands abroad and carries out his undertakings.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: THE GENTLE. Success through what is small. It furthers one to have somewhere to go. It furthers one to see the great man.

1.text_six: In advancing and in retreating, the perseverance of a warrior furthers.

2.text_nine: Penetration under the bed. Priests and magicians are used in great number. Good fortune. No blame.

3.text_nine: Repeated penetration. Humiliation.

4.text_six: Remorse vanishes. During the hunt three kinds of game are caught.

5.text_nine: Perseverance brings good fortune. Remorse vanishes. Nothing that does not further. No beginning, but an end. Before the change, three days. After the change, three days. Good fortune.

6.text_nine: Penetration under the bed. He loses his property and his ax. Perseverance brings misfortune.

structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Lakes resting one on the other. Thus the superior man joins with his friends for discussion and practice.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: THE JOYOUS. Success. Perseverance is favorable.

1.text_nine: Contented joyousness. Good fortune.

2.text_nine: Sincere joyousness. Good fortune. Remorse disappears.

3.text_six: Coming joyousness. Misfortune.

4.text_nine: Joyousness that is weighed is not at peace. After ridding himself of mistakes a man has joy.

5.text_nine: Sincerity toward disintegrating influences is dangerous.

6.text_six: Seductive joyousness.

structural_differential.object_level: The Image: The wind drives over the water. Thus the kings of old sacrificed to the Lord and built temples.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: DISPERSION. Success. The king approaches his temple. It furthers one to cross the great water. Perseverance furthers.

1.text_six: He brings help with the strength of a horse. Good fortune.

2.text_nine: At the dissolution he hurries to that which supports him. Remorse disappears.

3.text_six: He dissolves his self. No remorse.

4.text_six: He dissolves his bond with his group. Supreme good fortune. Dispersion leads in turn to accumulation. This is something that ordinary men do not think of.

5.text_nine: His loud cries are as dissolving as sweat. Dissolution! A king abides without blame.

6.text_nine: He dissolves his blood. Departing, keeping at a distance, going out, is without blame.

structural_differential.event_level: [Lake_Below ∧ Water_Above] → Water over lake, measured containment
structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Water over lake. Thus the superior man creates number and measure, and examines the nature of virtue and correct conduct.
structural_differential.label_level: The Judgment: LIMITATION. Success. Galling limitation must not be persevered in.

1.text_nine: Not going out of the door and the courtyard is without blame.

2.text_nine: Not going out of the gate and the courtyard brings misfortune.

3.text_six: He who knows no limitation will have cause to lament. No blame.

4.text_six: Contented limitation. Success.

5.text_nine: Sweet limitation brings good fortune. Going brings esteem.

6.text_six: Galling limitation. Perseverance brings misfortune. Remorse disappears.

structural_differential.event_level: [Lake_Below ∧ Wind_Above] → Wind over lake, inner emptiness
structural_differential.object_level: The Image: Wind over lake. Thus the superior man discusses criminal cases in order to delay executions.
